column4: Purpose
Sets the number of agents moving through the neighbourhood.
Starting probability that an agent considers stopping at a third place.
Represents how time-constrained or rushed an agent is.
Reduces stopping odds for agents with more fixed schedules.
Final probability that an agent stops, after schedule and social feedback effects.
Turns the familiarity feedback mechanism on or off.
Tracks accumulated co-presence / encounters experienced by an agent.
Increases stopping odds as agents accumulate familiarity through encounters.
Controls how strongly each encounter increases future stopping odds.
Scales model encounters into broader social familiarity.
Defines how far from their route agents are willing/able to search for a third place.
Controls how many route nodes are checked for nearby third-place options.
Adjusts search radius by agent schedule type.
Time rigid agents spend at a third place once they stop.
Time medium-flexibility agents spend at a third place once they stop.
Time flexible agents spend at a third place once they stop.
Agent-specific dwell time assigned from schedule profile.
Stylised attribute representing how economically accessible a third place is.
Stylised attribute representing how socially comfortable or inclusive a third place feels.
Measures how strongly an agent is attracted to affordable places.
Measures how strongly an agent is attracted to welcoming places.
Switches between random third-place choice and affordability/welcomingness-based choice.
Temporary score used to rank reachable third places for each agent.
Number of agents currently dwelling at a third place.
Total number of visits a third place has received.
Total accumulated overlap of visitors at a third place.
Highest number of agents present at the same third place at once.
Agent’s home location in the network.
Agent’s daily activity destination in the network.
Current destination node of the agent.
Indicates whether the agent is going to home, activity, or third place.
List of nodes forming the agent’s current route.
Tracks where the agent is along the route.
Indicates whether the agent is travelling or dwelling.
Total number of third-place visits made by an agent.
Total number of completed trips made by an agent.
